redfin.remarks: Welcome to this bright and inviting upper-level residence ideally located in the heart of Brentwood on iconic Montana Avenue. Offering nearly 600 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, this stylish pied--terre features an exceptionally functional layout with minimal wasted hallway space. The sun-filled interior includes a spacious living area that opens to a private balcony surrounded by lush greeneryan ideal setting for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or relaxing at the end of the day. The generously sized kitchen offers abundant cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a large refrigerator, and a comfortable dining area. The flexible sleeping area is enhanced by striking floor-to-ceiling frosted glass sliding doors, allowing the space to be opened up or closed off for additional privacy. Additional features include hard-surface flooring, a remodeled ensuite bathroom with a separate vanity area, and a large walk-in closet . Conveniently situated toward the rear of the secure building and near the elevator, the unit also includes gated parking . Residents enjoy access to a recently remodeled pool and spa, along with security service during designated evening hours. Ideally positioned just moments from Brentwood's popular boutiques, restaurants, cafs, and the Brentwood Farmers Market, this home offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy one of Los Angeles' most desirable neighborhoods. Whether you're looking for a primary residence, pied--terre, or investment opportunity, this Montana Avenue gem offers outstanding value in a premier location.
